study.question: Does the conditional click-AUC value of matching historical action values to advertisement context survive stopping the selected action-summary input derivatives, and does task-specific residual routing buffer or amplify that value?
study.hypothesis: Observation: r0037 stopped observed-minus-item-duplicate AUC is +0.002545782614 (task) and +0.002871054682 (shared). Replacement derivative blocking in r0036 changes task AUC by -0.000101411516, much less than this content contrast. Earlier attached alignment-minus-rotation losses in r0034/r0030 are +0.002512599397 (task) and +0.002774115398 (shared). These are single-seed conditional contrasts, not significance or total-action attribution. Mechanism hypothesis: joint action/target-match association supplies useful information beyond per-block action marginal composition; its usefulness persists without the selected summary derivative. Task-specific routing may buffer rather than amplify alignment loss. Rotation with stopped selected gradients distinguishes a forward association account from a selected-gradient-only account and avoids the item-duplicate content/rank substitution. Pool/ordinal actions and mask-derived feedback remain observed, so this cannot quantify all historical-action information.

nearest_work.difference: Read archived exact-version primary lines 235-280 (text SHA256 83fb9eeca31e2fa3c557b6f08b893ad0018cefb33da6e00952136b9ce17e607e), verifying target-conditioned unnormalized local activation. Inherit its local-activation adaptation and Dice usage in existing code; this conditional alignment/derivative attribution is neither an original DIN reproduction nor a new architecture or priority claim.

Read pinned benchmark forward lines 123-170, SHA256 e3750a73af1ceb6b2be4bf9355b70a9ad356985a3c465ef27238ef7e0f28fb4c: task-mask sequence hubs and task-token readout are closest task-conditioned context. This study retains the existing residual adapter bank and changes only selected action alignment; it introduces no INFNet hubs, broadcasts or stacked interactions. Original paper:infnet has link/provenance only and was not audited; no source-transfer effectiveness claim.

Exact materialized task source inspected and SHA256 verified (7b5bfdbf2f4b5ab5db957bf5ea95f28f201f17dfd269310d00633e6223f550f9). All executable model method arithmetic is reused. The new task cell changes only CONFIG and constructor default summary_rotation_group from none to match. Shared cell additionally selects existing shared routing. This is a missing conditional mechanism contrast, not novel modeling.

study.proposed_difference: Activate the inherited match-only rotation selector while keeping both selected summary derivatives blocked, crossing task/shared routing in two standalone modules. Reuse the two exact r0037 aligned observed-stop trials as controls. This completes the stopped-gradient alignment x routing contrast with only two new full units; historical attached-gradient cells provide a secondary gradient x alignment x routing comparison only after parity certification. No new learned state, width, mask, coefficient, pool, task representation or training setting is added.
predictions: Primary predeclared contrast: D_task=AUC(g1-r0037-match_observed_stop_task)-AUC(match_rotate_stop_task) and D_shared=AUC(g1-r0037-match_observed_stop_shared)-AUC(match_rotate_stop_shared). Both are predicted positive if conditional forward action/target association matters; no exact magnitude is promised.

Interaction I=D_task-D_shared: prior attached and content controls suggest a small negative value (task routing buffers damage), not evidence that task conditioning uniquely creates action utility. Estimate the signed interaction and avoid claiming its sign is stable from one seed.

If D remains positive with selected derivatives blocked, a selected-summary-gradient-only explanation is weakened. Compare D with attached D_task=0.002512599397 and D_shared=0.002774115398 only after cross-source parity; their difference is the conditional derivative interaction, not an additive decomposition of the incumbent gain.

At a fixed state, per-block valid action multisets/sums, all item summaries, ordinal action rows, pooling and scorer inputs remain invariant; match action summaries alone may change. Expected learned counts stay at the receipt values, but host must measure them. Predeclare full-population click AUC as primary; report click Logloss, all four task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary-only mean, available fixed history-length slices with sample/positive/negative counts and costs. Unavailable slices/paired user bootstrap are missing diagnostics, not negative evidence.
falsifiers: An aligned-minus-rotated loss near zero or negative weakens useful conditional alignment under the local derivative stop, even if item-duplicate removal still hurts. Do not claim equivalence or a precise null without repeated seeds/uncertainty.
A positive attached contrast that disappears under stop is consistent with selected optimization effects; it does not establish that forward action content lacks utility globally.

Absent or reversed routing interaction weakens a stable task-conditioning interaction account. A common alignment loss in both routes supports conditional alignment without proving task-specific dependence.

Any unintended change to masks, pool/ordinal action content, item summaries, modules, source/gradient ownership or Dice populations invalidates the intended contrast; equality of parameter count alone does not repair it.

Insufficient actually moved action content, failed ancestor parity, unbounded BF16 effects or missing host derivative diagnostics makes the result inconclusive; do not silently treat a successful training receipt as a passed mechanism check.
alternative_explanations: Training still adapts parameters and action embeddings through allowed pool/ordinal paths; selected local detach is not a global action-gradient removal
Rotation can change summary covariance, RMS and target-match association jointly; action multiset preservation does not match summary variance
Repeated action tokens, short or uniform blocks can make the fixed rotation an identity; no guarantee of complete destruction of semantic alignment
Task versus shared readout executes equal parameter banks, but activates different effective degrees of freedom and optimization geometry
All outcomes use a single frozen seed and an already explored validation set; cross-round bridges and requested host diagnostics have not been certified

Broad zero-action removal underperformed (r0024 task 0.6411900; context replacement 0.6414297) and isolated match-only/ordinal-only summaries without the pool underperformed (r0027 task 0.6514625/0.6530091); these failed performance directions motivate keeping complementary paths, not independent support for this conditional mechanism.

The incumbent remains 0.666753547526167, above r0037 observed-stop task 0.6661693800470533. This is mechanism research with no demonstrated quality improvement; frozen offline feedback and category/brand auxiliary-label semantics limit deployment interpretation.
